messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired INC-172525 - 5xx rate spike on /v1/generate (us-west1). 5xx=18% over 2m (threshold 5%). Multiple alert sources: gateway + tokenizer. Link: https://pd.example/INC-172525
ryan: ack — i'm oncall, joining. any known client impact?
maria: seeing increased 502s from inference-gateway v2. Logs show rapid KV cache misses and spike in upstream 504s to model-hosts. Support chatter: customer A and B seeing failures.
ryan: copying runbook. step1: verify scope. ryan: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep inference-gw` shows 3/5 pods restarting in us-west1.
sara: i'm going to scale inference pool by +2 while we triage. starting now.
devops-bot: scale action accepted: autoscaler.request(id=scale-1725252525) -> scale +2. Estimated warmup 60s.
maria: tail of gateway logs (latest):
```
2024-12-02T04:02:01Z inference-gw-1 ERROR upstream 502 model-host-12 tokenization timeout
2024-12-02T04:02:03Z inference-gw-3 WARN kv-cache miss key=ctx:abcd
```
ryan: good context. i'm going to temporarily route embeddings and lower-priority traffic to fallback-model-small to reduce pressure on model-host cluster. applying traffic-slice now.
sara: applied route rule `traffic-slice: fallback_small 20%` to us-west1.
maria: noticed PagerDuty sent two almost-simultaneous pages: INC-172525 and INC-172526 (tokenizer-timeout). both are same root cause. duplicates created auto-suppression conflict.
ryan: i'm manually suppressing follow-ups for INC-172526 to avoid thundering oncall. Marking as linked.
ryan: also initiating rolling restart of gateway sidecars to clear stuck connections (one at a time).
devops-bot: restart job queued: sidecar-restart-usw1 -> 5 pods sequential. ETA 120s per pod.
sara: support update: notified top-5 impacted customers, they report ~10% of requests failing at peak, mostly longer prompts. raising SLA risk.
maria: metric update: 5xx dropped from 18% -> 6% after scaling + routing (timestamp ~1725252560). continuing to watch.
ryan: fallback routing increased to 40% to accelerate stabilization.
aria_typo?: (note: typo in prior)
maria: errors trending down: now 2.3% at 1725252585. keeping sizing and restart in flight.
ryan: i'll keep the incident open for postmortem. creating a short timeline in the incident ticket and flagging for model-host team.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-172525 acknowledged by ryan. Escalation chain paused.
sara: postmortem checklist: collect request traces, KV cache eviction logs, and autoscaler timeline. I'll own the follow-up.
ryan: thanks all — handoff to morning oncall at shift-change. leaving note: do not revert fallback routing until model-host GC is validated.
maria: adding customer impact notes to PD incident. closing slack thread for live mitigation.
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Thread summary captured.
